sum_insured_options: ₹2L, ₹3L, ₹4L, ₹5L, ₹7L, ₹10L (as indicated by cardiac check-up tiers and premium illustrations)

room_rent.display: Single Private Room or 1% of SI/day
room_rent.note: Policy Schedule specifies either 'Single Private Room' or 'up to 1% of SI per day'. If room opted is higher than eligible, Associate Medical Expenses are pro-rated proportionally. NCB does not enhance room rent eligibility.

icu.display: Up to 2% of SI/day or no sub-limit
icu.note: Policy Schedule specifies either '2% of SI per day' or 'no sub-limit' for ICU charges. NCB does not enhance ICU eligibility.

copayment.note: Co-payment as specified in Policy Schedule applies on each claim for Benefits 1–5. Increases by 10% per claim in the policy year following insured (or eldest floater member) attaining age 71. If age at first policy issuance is 70 or below, insured can waive the additional 10% co-pay on payment of extra premium.

sub_limits.display: Cataract, knee replacement, hernia, hysterectomy, BPH, renal stones, cerebrovascular, cancer, renal complications, bone fractures capped per Policy Schedule
sub_limits.note: Named ailments/procedures (Clause 3.1.1(iii)(c)) have sub-limits specified in the Policy Schedule. All related expenses (pre/post/hospitalisation) count toward the sub-limit.

deductible.note: Deductible is an optional feature; if opted, it applies to Benefits 1–5 before insurer liability commences. Base policy has no mandatory deductible.

initial_waiting.note: Standard 30-day waiting period for illness treatment from first policy commencement date; not applicable for accidents.

ped_waiting.note: Pre-existing diseases excluded for 24 months of continuous coverage from inception. Portability credits reduce this period.

specific_disease_waiting.note: Listed conditions (e.g. cataract, hernia, hysterectomy, BPH, kidney stones, varicose veins, cancer, MI, renal failure, etc.) excluded for 24 months. If PED waiting period is longer, the longer applies.

maternity.note: Maternity (childbirth, complicated deliveries, C-sections, miscarriage, MTP) is a permanent standard exclusion (Code Excl18). No inbuilt or optional maternity benefit is offered under this product.

cumulative_bonus.note: 10% flat cumulative increase per claim-free policy year; maximum 50% of SI. Reduced by 10% of SI after a claim year but never below base SI. Alternatively, insured may opt for a small premium discount (₹49 individual / ₹99 floater) instead of additional SI.

restoration.note: Automatic Recharge reinstates up to 100% of base SI once per policy year after SI and NCB are fully exhausted. Recharge can only be used for a different illness/injury than the one that triggered exhaustion (unrelated). Unused recharge cannot be carried forward.

pre_hosp.note: Pre-hospitalisation medical expenses for 30 days prior to admission, for the same condition, reimbursement only.

post_hosp.note: Post-hospitalisation medical expenses for 60 days after discharge, for the same condition, reimbursement only.

day_care.note: Day care treatment covered up to SI; must be from the listed procedures in Annexure I.

domiciliary.note: Domiciliary hospitalisation covered (reimbursement only) if treatment exceeds 3 consecutive days. Excludes 12 specific conditions (asthma, bronchitis, diabetes, hypertension, epilepsy, etc.).

ayush.note: AYUSH in-patient treatment covered up to SI via cashless or reimbursement, provided linked to an admitted hospitalisation claim under Benefit 1.

organ_donor.note: Expenses related to donor treatment including surgery to remove organs from the donor are permanently excluded (Clause 4.2(a)(12)).

ambulance.display: Up to limit in Policy Schedule
ambulance.note: Ambulance cover amount specified in Policy Schedule; covers transport to nearest hospital or between hospitals in emergency. Exact rupee limit not stated in wording text.

modern_treatments.note: Covers: Uterine Artery Embolization, HIFU, Balloon Sinuplasty, Deep Brain Stimulation, Oral Chemotherapy, Immunotherapy (monoclonal antibody injections), Intravitreal injections, Robotic surgeries, Stereotactic radiosurgeries, Bronchial Thermoplasty, Vaporisation of prostate (green/holmium laser), IONM, Stem cell therapy (haematopoietic for bone marrow transplant). Other advanced technology methods are excluded.

consumables.note: Non-medical/consumable items (gloves, masks, ECG electrodes, nebulisation kits, etc.) are listed in Annexure II as excluded. No optional consumables rider offered.

global_cover.note: Policy covers only medical treatment taken entirely within India. International Second Opinion (Optional Benefit 2) is available but covers only a second medical opinion, not treatment costs abroad.

moratorium.note: After 5 continuous years, no look-back applied except for proven fraud and permanent exclusions. Moratorium applies separately to enhanced SI from date of enhancement.

grace_period.note: 15 days for monthly premium payment mode; 30 days for all other modes. Coverage not available during grace period.

free_look.note: Applicable on new policies only; not on renewals or porting/migration.

portability.note: Portability to other insurers permitted as per IRDAI guidelines; apply at least 30 days before but not earlier than 60 days from renewal date.

notable_exclusions.display: Maternity, organ donor surgery, non-listed advanced tech methods, external congenital anomaly, STDs (non-HIV), dental/eye/ear routine, sleep disorder devices, cochlear implants, tobacco/alcohol-related illness, pre-existing conditions listed in Clause 4.2(a)(24)

optional_riders.display: OPD Care (consultations/diagnostics/pharmacy), International Second Opinion, Home Care (qualified nurse post-discharge), Active Health Check-up (3x/yr), Deductible option
